James Freeman

History, politics and data: writing on modern British politics, visualisations of its numbers, and occasional notes on higher education and teaching.

Senior Academic Fellow in History and Associate Pro Vice-Chancellor (Education), Faculty of Arts, Law and Social Sciences, University of Bristol.
